local function calculate(a, operator, b)
    if operator == "+" then return a + b end
    if operator == "-" then return a - b end
    if operator == "*" then return a * b end
    if operator == "/" then
        if b == 0 then return nil, "division by zero" end
        return a / b
    end
    return nil, "unsupported operator"
end
local result, err = calculate(12, "+", 3)
if result ~= nil then print(result) else print(err) end
